application_type_full: Outline planning permission: All matters reserved
borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1"><!--[if !supportLists]-->1.<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</span><!--[endif]-->Insufficient evidence has been submitted to
indicate safe and accessible access arrangements to the site. No information
has been provided to demonstrate how new access arrangements will be implemented
off Gale Street noting the redline boundary does not adjoin the highway boundary.
The intensified use of the rear access road by pedestrians, vehicles, cyclists,
and servicing presents low quality inaccessible access arrangements presenting significant
highway and a pedestrian safety concerns.&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1"><!--[if !supportLists]-->1.<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</span><!--[endif]-->For reasons of size, scale, and layout insufficient
evidence has been submitted to demonstrate the maximum proposed quantum of
development would result in a development which provides good quality
accessible hotel rooms which are supported by communal amenity spaces, ancillary
facilities and are well lit by daylight, naturally ventilated by open windows harmful
to the standard of living of future guests. &nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1"><!--[if !supportLists]-->1.<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</span><!--[endif]-->Insufficient evidence has been submitted to
demonstrate the proposed development would be able to provide sufficient on-site
landscaping and external amenity space. The proposal is considered to constitute
overdeveloped and incongruous development which fails to enhance the quality
and appearance of the site or standard of living of existing and proposed
residents. &nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1"><!--[if !supportLists]-->1.<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</span><!--[endif]-->Insufficient evidence has been submitted to
indicate that the mass, bulk and height of the maximum proposed development will
not result in overshadowing and unacceptable loss of daylight and sunlight to
the allotment and residents of Malpas Road. Likewise, noting the proximity to the
existing units at 497-515 Gale Street the development would present overbearing
and unneighbourly development harmful to the standard of living of existing
residents and quality of open space. The proposal is considered unacceptable.&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p>
